description: Adds "human" to the producer allowlist: the manual-script flow lets an operator write their own narration instead of script_writer, so a script artifact can now legitimately come from either. No change to the payload shape — produced_by only gates writes, never reads — so this is a MINOR bump per RFC 0007: existing script@1.0.0 artifacts stay valid, consumers on ^1 keep working, and no migrator is needed.
